# Test fixtures

`OpAmpLabSoln.mlx` is a MATLAB live script saved by MATLAB (with outputs), from
[MathWorks-Teaching-Resources/DC-Circuit-Analysis](https://github.com/MathWorks-Teaching-Resources/DC-Circuit-Analysis)
(`InstructorResources/Solutions/OpAmpLabSoln.mlx`). Copyright The MathWorks, Inc.,
redistributed under the BSD 3-Clause license in `LICENSE-MathWorks.md`.

It is used as ground truth: the region map and output layout MATLAB saved in it
are what mlxkit's parser and writer are checked against.
